system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

Your strike are efficient brutal, refined by the aggression instilled into you by the side branch. Your strike reaches deep into your foe, causing server internal damage. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failed save the affected creature takes 1d6 necrotic and chakra damage for every rank dispelled in this way. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.
